summary: Represent new.target explicitly in lowered function calling conventions.

target.notes: Normal calls bind new.target to undefined. Construct calls bind it to the effective newTarget, which can differ from the current function under inheritance or Reflect.construct.

caveats: A simple boolean 'was called with new' loses the identity of the newTarget.
Reflect.construct can provide a distinct newTarget.

tests.name: distinguishes call from construction
tests.input: function F(){return new.target===undefined}; console.log(F(), new F());
tests.expected_behavior: plain call sees undefined; construction sees F
